programmes.title: Jambulingam
programmes.description: Hardworking villager Jambulingam decides to fight against the oppressive landlord who exploits the local people. He stands against the barbarities and atrocities inflicted upon the villagers.

programmes.title: Sankaranum Mohananum
programmes.description: Mohanakrishnan is a fashion photographer and his brother's ghost haunts him. He had died after being bitten by a snake, leaving behind a young wife.

programmes.title: Pigman
programmes.description: After his thesis gets rejected and he gets expelled from his college, the idealistic Sreekumar is left with no choice but to take up menial jobs in a pigsty.

programmes.title: Banking Hours 10 to 4
programmes.description: Three young men plot to rob a busy bank during its working hours. However, their plans go haywire after someone gets murdered in the bank premises, and they are accused of the crime.

programmes.title: Nagaram
programmes.description: When Kochi's waste crisis spirals out of control, a group of crooked politicians scheme to dump the garbage in a village.

programmes.title: Butterflies
programmes.description: Two friends, Prince and Sadasivan, agree to kidnap a girl for their friend, Pavithran. However, they find themselves in trouble when they abduct the wrong woman who then refuses to leave their house.

programmes.title: Gulumaal: The Escape
programmes.description: Jerry Matthews, a con man, breaks away from his family. One day, he meets an ex-convict with whom he plans a daunting heist.

programmes.title: Panchagni
programmes.description: Indira's life turns upside down after she gets a life sentence for murdering Avarachan, a landlord, who killed a young tribal woman after raping her.

programmes.title: Nakshathra Tharattu
programmes.description: Sunil falls head over heels in love with Hema and marries her. However, things take a turn when they both discover that they are orphans.

programmes.title: Simhasanam
programmes.description: Madhava Menon, a village chief who is highly respected for his integrity, faces trouble when a rival clan wreaks havoc in his village. Soon, his son decides to restore order.

programmes.title: C.I. Mahadevan 5 Adi 4 Inchu
programmes.description: Mahadevan, a policeman, goes to a village to find the criminals behind a bomb blast. He is determined to unravel the mystery behind the tragedy and gets help from a crazy bunch of local policemen.

programmes.title: Deepangal Sakshi
programmes.description: Rishi is a diligent collector who works honestly for the good of people. However, things take a turn after he draws the attention of corrupt politicians and businessmen who want to cause trouble.

programmes.title: Vinayapoorvam Vidyadharan
programmes.description: Vidyadharan is a simple bank employee, but his meagre earnings are insufficient for his wife's extravagant lifestyle. Eventually, she costs him his job, forcing him to struggle.

programmes.title: Nanma Niranjavan Srinivasan
programmes.description: Sreenivasan, a simple villager, is passionate about local theatre and hanging out with his friends. His life takes a turn when he applies for a job in the police department.

programmes.title: Senior Mandrake
programmes.description: Kuttan strikes it rich after selling a cursed statue. However, his luck changes when the statue mysteriously returns, bringing chaos into his household.

programmes.title: The Godman
programmes.description: Amarnath, a police officer, tries to settle a communal riot that has taken place among the fishermen. However, he faces many challenges as he strives to bring the criminals to justice.

programmes.title: Ayitham
programmes.description: Bhama falls in love with Shankaran, but she is forced to marry another man. However, her life takes a turn when she discovers that her husband is already married.

programmes.title: Nayika
programmes.description: Documentary filmmaker Aleena delves into the mysterious disappearance of the yesteryear Malayalam actress, Gracy, from the silver screen.

programmes.title: Joker
programmes.description: Babu perfects the art of being a clown and is promised the hand of Kamala, the circus owner's daughter. However, things take a turn when Sudheer Misra arrives in the troupe.

programmes.title: Bhimaa
programmes.description: After some mysterious instances at a temple of historical significance, a detective visits the region to investigate and find out the truth behind the incidents.

programmes.title: Comali
programmes.description: A long coma leaves Ravi disorientated in an unrecognisable world. However, he sets out on a journey to reclaim his past and adapt to a new reality.
